The audited HEAD is current: 'git rev-parse HEAD' printed ad2b434671caa767522789ad2f1e0956bfaecdea on branch master, and 'git status --short -- .github scripts' printed no line. Every non-deferred task is done with measured evidence: plan.md lines 66 to 69 hold tasks 4.1, 4.2, 4.3 and 4.4 as [x], and plan.md lines 71 to 73 hold tasks 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7 as [b] with deferred:pm, deferred:daniel and deferred:pm, so no human gate is claimed done. The gate 'CI=true pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 scripts/ci' at the audited head exited 0 with Test Files 9 passed (9) and Tests 150 passed (150), which matches the plan claim of task 4.4. The report check 'node /tmp/opencode/p4-red/report-check.cjs measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/dry-run-report.md' exited 0 with report_check=pass failed=none, report_rows=11 expected_rows=11 ids_match=1 bad_rows=0, first_push_plan_lines=1, affected_ids=10 and every R-2 and R-3 label at 1. The dry run claims nothing live: dry-run-report.md line 8 says no secret, no gcloud call and no workflow run, and line 30 says the push moves traffic for one app (www-reading-advantage) while eight apps build a no-traffic revision and reading-advantage is skipped. The reviews and the adversarial round saw the audited surface: 'git diff --stat 355079cb02889b42937953b4aa4b154cc0ebc734 ad2b434671caa767522789ad2f1e0956bfaecdea -- .github scripts measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/dry-run-report.md' printed no line, so the single commit after 355079cb0 is measure-only. The 17 commits of this track in the phase range touch only measure/tracks/per_app_cicd_20261107/** and one added test file, scripts/ci/__tests__/dry-run.test.mjs (p4_out_of_scope_paths=0), no header exceeds 98 characters, no dependency file changed, Red precedes Green (931c9f2a5 then 165bdb178), and no commit pushed, ran a workflow, called gcloud with a write, or moved traffic. Four prerequisite results report pass at 355079cb0, and the earlier review-a-p4-355079cb0.json and adversarial-p4-355079cb0.json are VOID because their sessions fell back to claude-haiku-5-5. No fake gate, no artifact-only test claiming live proof, no stale intentional-red test, no plan or commit-SHA mismatch, and no incomplete behavior was found. Three nonblocking findings remain: two open Review C notes about report wording and one worktree count drift.
nonblocking_findings: Review C N4 (still open, measured now): dry-run-report.md line 24 says "The word `traffic` names a class of apps in the table `scripts/ci/apps.json`". Command 'python3 -c ... open("scripts/ci/apps.json")' printed traffic occurrences: 0 and mode keys: cloudbuild, id, mode, path, project, region, service, tag, tagLength, tagPrefix with modes: direct, excluded, gated, so the table holds no traffic class. The word traffic is the plan-line key that the report check builds with pick("direct") at report-check.cjs line 46. Suggested fix in the report: "The plan-line key `traffic` lists the rows whose mode is `direct`."

Review C N5 (still open, measured now): dry-run-report.md line 24 and line 34 both use the word class for two different meanings, an app deploy group and a text class (no-text). Line 24 maps modes to traffic, no_traffic and skipped, and line 34 calls the www row class no-text (test only). Suggested fix: use group or mode on line 24, which the N4 fix already does.

Worktree count drift: 'git worktree list | wc -l' printed 8, while test-strategy.md line 868 (P4.6 item 10) expects the phase-start count of 9. A worktree was removed after the phase start, so this phase added no worktree and the A16 defense holds. The drift is a count difference in the other direction, not a new worktree.

Known open items, recorded and not failed on: D5 (pnpm architecture:check stays red on master with "V2 reconciliation manifest is invalid: Analyzer input snapshot hash does not match current bytes"; a separate track owns it, and it is not a vitest suite); the follow-up track sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108 owns the traffic source binding, and per_app_cicd tasks 2.3c and 2.3h stay its deferred live proofs as [b] deferred:daniel (plan.md lines 36 and 41); the master push waits for this phase and for the PR check of the www text, so tasks 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7 stay [b] human-gated (plan.md lines 71 to 73).
